name: cl-transfer-pricing
description: Chile transfer pricing (precios de transferencia) for tax year 2026 (año comercial 2026, año tributario 2027) under LIR art. 41 E. Covers who is related (art. 41 E No. 1, including any party in a preferential tax regime under art. 41 H and back-to-back deals), the arm's length rule for cross-border operations and business restructurings, the six methods and the most appropriate method, the interquartile range and the median, SII adjustments taxed with the art. 21 sole tax plus a 5% fine, the taxpayer's own upward self-adjustment, corresponding adjustments, advance pricing agreements, and the annual sworn statements: DJ 1907 (medium and large companies, or related operations over CLP 500 million), DJ 1951 local file (over CLP 200 million), DJ 1950 master file and DJ 1937 country-by-country report (groups of EUR 750 million), due 30 June, with the 10 to 50 UTA fine.
